name: Rolling Green Fairways RV Park
note: RV park set inside the back nine of an 18-hole golf course on the western edge of Lloydminster, with a restaurant at the clubhouse. Besides nightly stays it sells weekly, monthly and May-October seasonal sites and courts contract workers; how much of the park goes by the night is not published. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator page https://rollinggreen.ca/rv-park/ (read 2026-11-19): '70+ Serviced RV Sites, Shower House, Laundromat, Playground', daily rates full hook-up 30 A C$42 / 50 A C$48 / partial (30 A + water) C$37 plus GST, weekly/monthly and a new May 1-Oct 1 seasonal rate, 'welcome contract and short-term workers, as well as wedding guests, sports teams, and holiday travellers', booking request form + phone 780-808-1667 + rvpark@rollinggreen.ca, 'ALL SITES MUST BE PAID IN ADVANCE (Stop at the office or attendant will call)'; City of Lloydminster campgrounds page (read 2026-11-19) lists it with the same phone; Travel Alberta listing 14290 (read 2026-11-19): 80 sites in the back nine, 30 pull-through, 50 full-service, 30 partial-service; Google Maps 'Rolling Green Fairways Golf Course and RV Park' 4.5 (216), phone, open - rating SHARED with the golf course, restaurant and event venue (most reviews are weddings/catering); RV Life 3.5*/$$ (3 old reviews). Long-stay tests: nights for sale with no application or lease (request form + walk-up), no posted minimum, no lots or homes sold; nightly share unmeasured, but Esri imagery 2015-05-21, 2023-09-15 and 2024 shows occupancy swinging from ~10 of the east loops' ~45 pads (Sep 2023) to most pads full (2024) - pads turn over, not a wall of parked seasonals. Price gate: cheapest electric night C$37 (partial 30 A + water), full 30 A C$42, both <= C$69 -> pass (gateways.py: none within 40 km; not needed). Not a duplicate: nothing in the DB within 3 km (CampN RV 9119 is ~9 km west).
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-19: Esri World Imagery export (sat.py, 1800 m and 400 m frames at 53.2903,-110.0717 and 180 m frames at -110.0735/-110.0700, 2024 County of Vermilion River orthophoto, all rendered) plus Esri Wayback releases 56450 (2023-09-15) and 5359 (2015-05-21) at z18 (rendered). The RV loops sit on open grass inside the golf course; the only water near the sites is a golf-course pond (~35 m across, well under 2 ha) north of the park's main perimeter road, ~40 m from the nearest pads with that road and a grassy bank between - a pond across a road is not waterfront under the doc. Other course ponds and a farm slough ~1 km north are farther off. -> not waterfront.

fees.note: Daily: partial hook-up (30 A + water) C$37, full hook-up 30 A C$42, full hook-up 50 A C$48, plus GST. Weekly C$270-300 and monthly C$980-1,100; May 1-October 1 seasonal from C$4,250; RV-and-golf 'Stay & Play' packages.

flags: Nightly share unmeasured: the operator courts contract workers (Lloydminster oil town) and sells weekly/monthly/seasonal sites; no site split is published and Google review search needs a sign-in. Imagery shows pads turning over between captures (Sep 2023 mostly empty, 2024 mostly full), so not a permanent-seasonal park - the reviewer may still want to weigh the workforce mix.
Google 4.5 (216) is shared with the golf course, restaurant and wedding venue - not the RV park's alone. RV Life 3.5* rests on 3 old reviews.
No online booking engine: request form, phone or email; pay in advance at the office.

Season not sourced: the 2026 page said 'Opening Day is TBA' and the home page now shows the RV park 'CLOSED for the season'; the seasonal rate runs May 1-Oct 1 but that is a rate period, so no season group was written. Travel Alberta says spring/summer/fall; a YP listing's 'four-season' claim was not used.
Name: the city page spells it 'Rolling Greens Fairways'; the operator, Travel Alberta and Google use 'Rolling Green Fairways'.
Pin set on the RV loops (~470 m NE of Google's clubhouse pin 53.28697,-110.07592).
